description: This Java class 'JsonObjectInjectAdapter' implements the 'TextMap' interface from the OpenTracing API, providing an adapter that injects tracing span context properties into a Vert.x JsonObject. It essentially acts as a bridge between OpenTracing and Vert.x JsonObject for span context injection.

classes.name: JsonObjectInjectAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class implementing TextMap to allow injection of tracing information into a JsonObject.

methods.name: JsonObjectInjectAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a JsonObject and ensures it is not null.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException, as this implementation is only for injection, not extraction.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the JsonObject, used for injecting tracing span context.
